context: M22 o3. The Shamrock Rail. Every cop at the bar staring at the TV. Mayhew grabs Teddy's sleeve.

lines.speaker: char.carl_mayhew
lines.text: You wore a wire. Wurtz's man at the DA's office saw your name. A wire, kid!

lines.speaker: char.teddy_arce
lines.text: You drove me to a meet in seventy-one, Carl. I'm just returning the favour.

lines.speaker: char.carl_mayhew
lines.text: The book's gone from Lisle's office. Everybody knows it's you. Everybody!

lines.speaker: char.teddy_arce
lines.text: Then everybody knows who to be nice to.

lines.speaker: char.carl_mayhew
lines.text: He's going down tonight, the President. Everybody's going down. Who's next, kid?

lines.speaker: char.teddy_arce
lines.text: Go home, Carl. Sleep. Tomorrow you decide who you are.
